description: Integration tests that exercise provider handoff: start a session on one provider, switch mid-conversation to another, verify message continuity and tool-call round-tripping. Covers Anthropic <-> OpenAI Completions, Anthropic <-> OpenAI Responses, Anthropic <-> Google, and Anthropic <-> Bedrock. Tests should run against live APIs (gated behind env vars like the existing live tests).
title: Cross-provider handoff integration tests
